show: Life Will Be the Death of Me with Chelsea Handler

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Chelsea Handler chats with Anna Faris about aging, comedy, and life's unexpected turns.
kurzfassung: Chelsea Handler and her guests discuss the bittersweet realities of aging, career milestones, and the importance of supporting friends through tough times. Anna Faris joins to talk about her role in the upcoming movie Spa Weekend, revisiting the Scary Movie franchise, and embracing self-confidence later in life. The episode also features listener advice calls regarding domestic tension and remote work isolation.
stichpunkte: Chelsea Handler promotes her High and Mighty Tour dates across the US and Canada.
The hosts reflect on the tragic passing of Hayden Panettiere and emphasize the importance of looking out for friends in crisis.
Anna Faris appears as the guest, discussing her life in Spain and recovering from a heat stroke.
Faris opens up about losing her home in the Palisades fire and how she leaned into gratitude.
Faris shares her journey of feeling burnt out, dealing with premenopausal depression, and contemplating retirement.
The discussion turns to returning to the Scary Movie franchise and reuniting with the Wayans brothers.
Faris and Handler compare notes on marriage, personal growth, and the wisdom that comes with getting older.
The show takes listener calls to offer advice on living with a difficult mother-in-law and coping with isolation as a remote software architect.

kapitel.titel: Tour Dates and Remembering Hayden Panettiere
Welcoming Anna Faris and Discussing Aging
Reflecting on Career, Scary Movie, and Personal Growth
Advice for Courtney: Living with a Difficult Mother-in-Law
Advice for Pablo: Overcoming Remote Work Isolation

clips.hook: People need support when asking for help
clips.text: Chelsea Handler announces the upcoming schedule for her High and Mighty comedy tour starting this September.
After losing her home, Chelsea Handler chose to focus on extreme gratitude rather than succumbing to resentment and anger.
The hosts discuss how childhood experiences shaped their resilience and their tendency to endure difficult treatment from others.
Chelsea Handler reflects on her past lack of awareness and personal growth by recalling her appearance during her early career.

clips.hook: Wanting a mother-in-law to move into a retirement home
clips.text: Anna Faris and Chelsea Handler discuss the evolution of the podcasting industry and the reasons behind Faris stepping away from her show.

beschreibung:
Anna Faris joins Chelsea to talk about processing the loss of her home in the fires last year, parenting when your kid wants to convert you, and why she left her mega-popular podcast. Then: A happily married man realizes he and his husband never leave the house. And a mom of two struggles when she moves in with her MIL.
